# PathDiversityMetric

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A metric capturing the distribution and count of alternative shortest paths, beyond simple path existence or length. Provides a richer characterization of network robustness and computational capacity in neuromorphic substrates.
